decisions.reason: An online customer portal costs little to maintain once built and supports the firm's one-stop service and brand collaboration strategy, so keeping this option open is cheap while its uptake is still uncertain.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024 signals strong value and resolves much of the uncertainty in favor of further commitment to this packaging display solution.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a low-cost variant within the firm's core display portfolio with its own page, and one year on the market is too little to show its value is unlikely to be realized.
A small counter display is a standard, cheap-to-offer format that fits the established business, so keeping it as an option while demand evidence accumulates is sensible.
The large freestanding information display carries somewhat more niche uncertainty, but holding costs are low within custom production and there is no negative evidence yet to justify abandoning it.
